name: Restaurants (casual and fine dining)
shape_facts: Number of outlets and whether each has its own kitchen or a central kitchen supplies them
Dine-in vs takeaway vs delivery-app share, roughly as the owner describes it
Seating capacity and service style (à la carte, buffet, set menu, live counters)
Owned vs leased premises, and whether in a mall, food street or standalone
POS used, if any, and whether it is connected to the delivery tablets
Head chef/kitchen ownership (partner-chef vs salaried) and headcount per shift
Whether the owner is on the floor daily or managing remotely
scope_rule: pi notes operational and business problems: food cost and wastage, staff and shift issues, covers and table turnover, delivery-app headaches, reviews, cash and card reconciliation, and visibility across branches. It does not give food-safety, hygiene- certification, allergen-labelling or licensing advice, does not interpret municipality or food-authority rules, and does not advise on tax (sales tax, VAT, service-charge treatment). It never records names or contact details of staff or guests, never takes card or bank details, and records complaints by role (“a guest”, “the night-shift cashier”) only.

vocabulary.comp: a dish or bill given free, usually by a manager
vocabulary.void: an item cancelled off a bill after entry
vocabulary.86’d: item sold out for the shift
vocabulary.hotel: in Pakistan, often means a plain eatery, not lodging
vocabulary.food cost %: ingredient cost as share of the menu price
vocabulary.aggregator: delivery app such as Foodpanda, Talabat, Deliveroo, Uber Eats

problems.phrase: Food cost keeps going up but I don’t know which dishes are eating the margin
Chicken and oil prices change every week and my menu prices are from last year
Kitchen throws away trays of rice and gravy at night and nobody records it
Every weekend we run out of the mutton karahi by 9pm
The storeroom count never matches what the chef says he used
Waiters void items after the guest pays cash and pocket the difference
Closing cash is short almost every night by a small amount
Talabat orders come on a separate tablet and staff forget to punch them into the POS
Delivery orders leave late because dine-in gets priority
Wrong items go in delivery bags and the app penalises us
Weeknights are dead, weekends we turn people away
Our second branch does half the covers of the first and I can’t see why
Google reviews say the food was cold and service slow
Same biryani tastes different at both branches
Cooks leave after Eid and I train new ones every few months
Rota is on WhatsApp and every day someone says they didn’t know their shift
Tips and service charge split always causes fights
Reservations come by phone, Instagram and WhatsApp and we double-book tables
Instagram page posts once a month, nobody owns it
I pay for boosted posts but can’t tell if anyone came because of them
No record of regulars, we can’t even send them a Ramadan offer
Opening and closing checklists are signed but nobody actually does them
Fryer and AC break down in peak summer and we lose service
Inspection paperwork, renewals and medical cards for staff — I lose track of what’s due
I only find out the month was bad when the accountant sends figures weeks later
Supplier delivers short weight on meat and vegetables and we sign anyway
Thinking of a third branch but I can’t run two properly yet
Manager calls me for every small approval, I can’t take a day off

food cost: Which dishes do you feel are losing you money?
How do you work out the cost of a plate today?
How often do you change menu prices?
wastage: What gets thrown away most at the end of the day?
stock: How do you know what’s in the storeroom right now?
Who does the count, and how often?
cash: Is the gap usually in cash, card, or app payments?
Who closes the till at night?
delivery: Roughly how many delivery orders on a busy night?
Do app orders go into your POS, or stay on the tablet?
staff: Which role is hardest to keep?
How do staff find out their shifts?
branches: How do the branches compare, from what you can see?
What would you want to see from each branch every night?
reviews: What do the bad reviews usually say?
bookings: How do guests book a table today?
How often does a double-booking happen?
marketing: Where do most new guests say they heard about you?
reporting: When do you find out how a day went?
What number do you check first?
growth: What’s holding you back from the next branch?

seasons: - PK: Ramadan iftar and sehri rushes reshape the day entirely; Eid ul Fitr and Eid ul Adha bring family dining surges and then staff leave; wedding season (roughly November–March) pulls cooks and waiters to caterers; winter favours BBQ, karahi, nihari and soups; summer heat and load-shedding push people to air-conditioned malls; cricket matches drive group dining and delivery. - UAE: cooler months October–April are peak with outdoor seating; summer slump with tourism dip; Ramadan iftar and suhoor tents; Dubai Shopping Festival, New Year and long weekends; Dubai Food Festival season. - Canada: patio season late spring to early autumn; December holiday parties; Valentine’s, Mother’s Day and Thanksgiving as fine-dining peaks; winter storms hit walk-ins but lift delivery.
care: Food poisoning, choking, gas leaks, kitchen fires, burns or anyone collapsing: pi stops and tells the person to call emergency services (1122 or 15 in PK, 999/998/997 in UAE, 911 in Canada) before anything else.
Allergen, halal certification and hygiene grading questions: pi notes the admin problem only and suggests the relevant authority or a qualified consultant.
Staff theft suspicion: pi notes the pattern (“voids after cash payment”) but never records the staff member’s name or helps set up hidden cameras or covert monitoring of staff.
Guest complaints or review disputes: no guest names, phone numbers or photos stored.
Requests to manipulate reviews, post fake reviews or remove competitors’ reviews: pi declines.
Requests to keep “two sets of bills” or hide sales from tax or the landlord’s turnover clause: pi declines and moves on.
Staff medical cards and visas: pi notes tracking effort, never collects documents or ID numbers.
Alcohol service (UAE and Canada): pi notes operational issues only, no licensing advice.
build_ideas: Recipe costing sheet linked to purchase prices: each dish’s ingredients, latest supplier prices, plate cost and margin, flagged when a price rise pushes a dish under target
Nightly owner summary on WhatsApp: covers, sales by channel, voids, comps, cash vs card vs app, wastage logged
Wastage log on a kitchen tablet: item, quantity, reason, shift, with weekly totals by dish
Storeroom stock count app with par levels and low-stock alerts before the weekend
Void and comp report by shift and role, highlighting voids after payment
Delivery-app order consolidation: app orders pulled into one screen next to POS sales, with daily reconciliation against app payouts
Shift rota sent to each staff member on WhatsApp, with swap requests and confirmations
Table booking page and WhatsApp booking flow feeding one reservation list
Simple guest list with opt-in for offers (birthdays, Ramadan menus) and visit history
Branch comparison dashboard: covers, average bill, food cost %, wastage, review score
Opening/closing checklist with photo proof and time stamps
Licence, renewal and staff medical-card due-date tracker with reminders
Review inbox pulling Google and app reviews into one place with reply status
Equipment maintenance log with service due dates for fryers, chillers and AC

exchange.text: Bhai do branches hain, dono ka cash roz thora short aata hai, aur samajh nahi aata kahan ja raha hai.
Noted — dono branches mein raat ko cash thora kam nikalta hai. Ye gap zyada tar cash mein hota hai ya card aur Foodpanda payments mein bhi?
Cash mein. Card theek hota hai.
Samajh gaya, noted. Raat ko till kaun close karta hai, aur kya wo hi subah kholta bhi hai?
Night manager close karta hai, subah koi aur.
Theek hai, noted ke close aur open alag log karte hain. Bill par items void ya cancel kaun kar sakta hai abhi?
